packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the Go port and no longer exposes the JavaScript compiler API. @vercel/ncc's ts-loader calls ts.sys.fileExists(), so `npm run build` crashes while bundling every action. Reproduced on ncc 0.44.1 and 0.45.0; see https://github.com/vercel/ncc/issues/1336. Lift this once ncc supports TS 7 or the actions stop being bundled with ncc.
